shellCommands.command: test -d node_modules && echo node_modules-present || echo node_modules-absent; git diff -- package.json; node --version
git status --short && git diff -- next.config.ts lib/products.ts 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx' tsconfig.json
git diff -- next-env.d.ts; git ls-files .next | head

node --input-type=module -e 'const cases=[["lamp","EUR","Brass lamp","EUR 110.40"],["lamp","USD","Brass lamp","USD 120.00"],["vase","EUR","Stone vase","EUR 73.60"],["vase","USD","Stone vase","USD 80.00"]]; for(const [slug,currency,name,price] of cases){const r=await fetch(`http://localhost:3100/products/${slug}?currency=${currency}`); const html=await r.text(); const ok=r.status===200&&html.includes(name)&&html.includes(price)&&html.includes("Related products")&&html.includes("Loading related products"); console.log(`${r.status} ${slug} ${currency}: ${ok?"PASS":"FAIL"} (${name}, ${price})`); if(!ok)process.exitCode=1} const missing=await fetch("http://localhost:3100/products/unknown");console.log(`${missing.status} unknown: ${missing.status===404?"PASS":"FAIL"}`);if(missing.status!==404)process.exitCode=1'

node --input-type=module -e 'for(const [slug,currency] of [["lamp","EUR"],["lamp","USD"],["vase","EUR"],["vase","USD"],["unknown","USD"]]){const r=await fetch(`http://localhost:3100/products/${slug}?currency=${currency}`);const h=await r.text();console.log(slug,currency,r.status,h.length,Object.fromEntries(["Brass lamp","Stone vase","EUR 110.40","USD 120.00","EUR 73.60","USD 80.00","Related products","Loading related products","Loading product details"].map(s=>[s,h.includes(s)])))}'

node --input-type=module -e 'const cases=[["lamp","EUR","Brass lamp","EUR 110.40","USD 120.00"],["lamp","USD","Brass lamp","USD 120.00","EUR 110.40"],["vase","EUR","Stone vase","EUR 73.60","USD 80.00"],["vase","USD","Stone vase","USD 80.00","EUR 73.60"]];for(const [slug,currency,name,price,wrongPrice] of cases){const r=await fetch(`http://localhost:3100/products/${slug}?currency=${currency}`);const html=await r.text();const ok=r.status===200&&html.includes(name)&&html.includes(price)&&!html.includes(wrongPrice)&&html.includes("Loading product details")&&html.includes("Loading related products");console.log(`${slug} ${currency}: ${ok?"PASS":"FAIL"} (HTTP ${r.status})`);if(!ok)process.exitCode=1}'
git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff --check
